description: This file defines a React functional component 'AddHabitModal' used for adding new habits through a controlled modal interface. It manages internal state for user input, handles form submission, and interacts with an external data client to create habits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the input fields and error state to initial values.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates input, calls createHabit API, and manages submission state and errors.
